title: Special purpose revenue bonds exempt from taxation.
bodyText: Special purpose revenue bonds and the income derived from the bonds issued pursuant to this part shall be exempt from all state, county, and municipal taxation, except for inheritance, transfer, and estate taxes.
bodyHtml: [§39A-264]  Special purpose revenue bonds exempt from taxation.  Special purpose revenue bonds and the income derived from the bonds issued pursuant to this part shall be exempt from all state, county, and municipal taxation, except for inheritance, transfer, and estate taxes. [L 2002, c 257, pt of §1]
